description: Replace an existing item's coordinates with a new (x, y) without retyping its content. Works for every item kind: `text` and `link` set the top-left to (x, y); `line` translates every point so the stroke's bounding box top-left lands at (x, y) and detaches any connector anchors. `image` sets the top-left like text. Moving text or an image also moves any stroke endpoints anchored to it. `kind` defaults to `text` for backward compat with older callers. Find the id + kind via `get_board`. Prefer `move` over re-creating an item when only the location changes — it preserves the id, content, author and avoids a round-trip of base64 bytes for images.

access_key.description: Board key for direct MCP clients that handle credentials outside chat. Accepts an 8-character key or a legacy 6-character key. Keep the key out of chat and use the browser or an MCP client configured with the X-Board-Key header.
